sceneTransmission.encoding: optical-reflection RGB = linear reflected radiance * reflectionEncodingScale; A = geometric coverage. No color conversion. Premultiply once when compositing the optical map; unpremultiply before decoding its radiance.
sceneTransmission.fallback: shell/body/wall/reflection are legacy source-over approximations; do not stack them on the scene-transmission pass.
